account.title: Account Settings
account.description: Manage account information, security, and ViRead usage options.
account.readingRemindersDescription: Adjust reading schedules and reminders for your child.
account.loadErrorBody: ViRead could not load account data. Please reload the page or log in again.
account.emailPendingBody: Email change request is pending verification. The current email remains the previously verified address.
account.emailDefaultBody: To change your email or resend a verification email, use the existing feature in the parent profile.

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Use a separate password to protect your account.
password.minLengthHint: New password must be at least {min} characters long.
password.noPasswordDescription: This account does not have a password login method yet. Parents can request a password reset link via email.
password.requestRecoveryButton: No password? Send a password reset link via email
password.changedSuccess: Password updated. Your current session remains active.
password.changeError: Unable to change password. Please check your connection and try again.
password.noEmailForRecovery: No email address on file to send a password reset link.
password.recoverySent: Supabase Auth has received the password reset request. Please check your inbox and spam folder.

language.heading: Display Language
language.description: Choose the language for navigation and settings. Vietnamese book content remains unchanged.
language.learningContentNote: Changing the language only affects navigation, buttons, and settings. Vietnamese books, OCR, voice recognition (STT), and sample audio (TTS) remain in Vietnamese.
